chapter.title: Mercenary: Foxwell Enforcement
chapter.summary: Security work from Yellow up to Red Level contracts.

objectives.title: Foxwell: intro contracts
objectives.why: Starts Foxwell standing. Each intro gives 100 reputation.

steps.do: Accept and finish "Exciting New Opportunities with Foxwell Enforcement".
Accept and finish "Still Looking for Work?" when it is offered.

contracts: Exciting New Opportunities with Foxwell Enforcement

objectives.title: Reach Foxwell Jr. Contractor (800 rep)
objectives.why: Neutral-rank Foxwell contracts (e.g. "Yellow Level Contract: Clear Out PAF") give 100 reputation each.

steps.do: Take Foxwell Yellow Level contracts. Count each one here.
steps.done_when: "Yellow Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks" is offered.

contracts: Yellow Level Contract: Clear Out PAF
Yellow Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks

objectives.title: Reach Foxwell Contractor (2,200 rep)
objectives.why: Jr. Contractor contracts give 100-150 reputation each.

steps.do: Take Foxwell contracts open to Jr. Contractors. Count each one here.
steps.done_when: "Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks" is offered.

contracts: Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks

objectives.title: Reach Foxwell Sr. Contractor (5,800 rep)
objectives.why: Contractor-rank contracts give about 150 reputation. Sr. Contractor opens Red Level contracts.

steps.do: Take Orange Level contracts. Count each one here.
steps.done_when: "Red Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks" is offered.

contracts: Red Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks

objectives.title: Reach Foxwell Veteran Contractor (15,000 rep)
objectives.why: Sr. Contractor contracts give about 200 reputation each.

steps.do: Take Red and Orange Level contracts. Count each one here.
steps.done_when: "Red Level Contract: High-Risk Security Patrol" is offered.

contracts: Red Level Contract: High-Risk Security Patrol
